create_thread_meta: create a new thread metadata row with thread_id, assistant_id, user_id, display_name, and metadata
get_thread_meta: get the thread metadata row for a given thread_id with optional user ownership verification
check_thread_access: check if a user has access to a thread in permissive or strict mode
search_threads: search threads by metadata filters and status with pagination and user ownership enforcement
update_thread_metadata: merge new metadata into an existing thread row with ownership verification and read-modify-write semantics
